description: This Python module handles SQLite database connection, schema initialization, and utility functions for a backend API, including user management, schema migrations, and database health checks.

classes.name: AuthService
classes.description: Authentication service used for password hashing and user management.

methods.name: _default_db_path
methods.description: Computes a deterministic default database path based on the container root.

methods.name: _fallback_db_path
methods.description: Provides a writable fallback path in /tmp for the database.

methods.name: _connect_sqlite
methods.description: Creates a SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled and row factory set.

methods.name: _ensure_parent_dir
methods.description: Ensures the parent directory exists for a given database path.

methods.name: _ensure_system_user
methods.description: Ensures a 'system' user exists in the users table, creating or updating as necessary.

methods.name: get_db_path
methods.description: Returns the database path, resolving environment variables and relative paths.

methods.name: get_connection
methods.description: Returns a singleton SQLite connection, attempting fallback paths or in-memory if needed.

methods.name: db_status
methods.description: Checks database connectivity and returns status info.

methods.name: init_db
methods.description: Initializes the database schema, creating tables and indexes.

methods.name: seed_test_users
methods.description: Seeds the database with test users for development/testing.
